title: Parse explicit Notes heading into document notes
description: Change shopping list markdown parsing to recognize the first `## Notes` block verbatim, capture its content into `document.notes`, and stop preserving arbitrary unmodelled header free text.
acceptance_criteria: When the parser encounters a trimmed `## Notes` heading, it captures subsequent lines until the next `## ` heading or EOF.
Captured notes preserve internal blank lines and markdown markup verbatim, trimming only one trailing newline from the collected block.
If multiple `## Notes` blocks exist, only the first populates `document.notes`; later ones are ignored.
Files without a `## Notes` block parse with `notes == ""`.
Unmodelled non-Notes free text is no longer preserved for re-rendering.

handoff_summary.completed: - Added `.notes` and `.ignored` cases to the `CurrentSection` enum. - `## Notes` heading (case-insensitive) routes to `.notes` on first encounter; subsequent `## Notes` blocks route to `.ignored` and are discarded. - Notes lines accumulated in `notesLines`; on flush, joined with `\n` then exactly one trailing newline stripped. - Pre-heading free text (`.pre` section) is now discarded — no longer flows into `notes`. - `renderMarkdown()` wraps non-empty notes in `## Notes\n<content>`. - Build passes cleanly (`swift build` — Build complete).
handoff_summary.remaining: Test coverage for the new parsing behaviour (no-notes file, single Notes block, multiple Notes blocks, blank-line preservation, round-trip) should be added by the tester agent.
handoff_summary.risks: Any existing tests that relied on pre-heading free text flowing into `notes` will now fail — that behaviour was intentionally removed per acceptance criteria #5. Tests should be updated to use explicit `## Notes` blocks.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should add/update unit tests covering: no-Notes file yields empty notes, single Notes block captured verbatim with internal blank lines, second Notes block ignored, one trailing newline trimmed, round-trip fixed-point, pre-heading free text no longer in notes.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Existing tests exercising the old behaviour (free text before `##` headings landing in `notes`) will break and must be updated. No file-scope conflicts with other running beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: The expected_files bead spec named `ShoppingListDocumentParser.swift` (a separate file that doesn't exist). The parsing logic lives inside `ShoppingListDocument.swift` as an `init(markdown:)` extension — consistent with existing codebase convention. Edits were made there rather than creating a new empty file.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added — test execution is the tester agent's responsibility.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The `notesLines` reset inside `flush()` is redundant once `notesFound` is set (we never re-enter `.notes`), but is kept for clarity and defensive correctness.

conflict_risks: Existing tests exercising the old behaviour (free text before `##` headings landing in `notes`) will break and must be updated. No file-scope conflicts with other running beads.

execution_history.summary: Updated ShoppingListDocument.swift to parse explicit `## Notes` blocks into `document.notes` and stop preserving arbitrary pre-heading free text. Render now wraps notes in a `## Notes` heading for round-trip fidelity.
